skill.name: skill-installer
skill.description: List and install Codex skills from curated collections or GitHub repository paths, including private repositories.
skill.summary: Discover and install GitHub-hosted skills into the configured Codex skills directory.
skill.author: openai

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally uses GitHub networking, optional tokens, Git subprocesses, and filesystem writes to install skills. Most Markdown, SVG, path-string, and guarded archive findings are false positives. Arbitrary remote skill content is copied into the active skills directory without trust verification, creating a supply-chain risk.

remediation.issue: Remote skills are activated without publisher or content verification.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit source confirmation, pin immutable commits, verify expected digests, and scan skill content before installation.

remediation.issue: Downloads and extracted archives have no resource limits.
remediation.suggestion: Stream downloads with byte limits and reject archives that exceed compressed size, expanded size, or file-count quotas.

semantic_findings.title: Unreviewed Remote Skill Installation
semantic_findings.description: The installer copies arbitrary GitHub skill content into the active skills directory after checking only for SKILL.md. It does not verify publisher trust, signatures, or content safety.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The validation and copy flow is explicit, and no trust or content-review control exists.

semantic_findings.title: Unbounded Download and Archive Extraction
semantic_findings.description: The HTTP helper reads complete responses into memory, and archive extraction has no size or file-count limits. Large repositories can exhaust memory or disk.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The response is buffered without a cap, and extraction performs no quota checks.

content.value_statement: Finding and installing compatible skills manually takes time and risks incorrect placement. This skill lists available packages and installs selected GitHub skills into the configured Codex directory.
actual_capabilities: Lists skill directories from a configured GitHub repository path.
Marks listed skills already present under the local Codex skills directory.
Installs one or multiple skill folders from public or private GitHub repositories.
Supports direct archive download and sparse Git checkout fallback.
Validates source paths, destination names, archive members, and required SKILL.md files.
Preserves existing installations by refusing to overwrite destination directories.
limitations: Requires network access and may require a GitHub authentication token.
Does not assess the trust or safety of installed skill content.
Does not update or overwrite an existing skill directory.

use_cases.title: Discover curated skills
use_cases.description: List the default curated collection and identify packages that are already installed.

use_cases.title: Install a team skill
use_cases.description: Install an internal skill from a private GitHub repository using existing credentials or a token.

use_cases.title: Provision multiple skills
use_cases.description: Install several skill folders from one repository into a custom destination.

prompt_templates.title: List curated skills
prompt_templates.prompt: List skills from the default curated collection. Mark which skills are already installed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin by reviewing the official curated collection.

prompt_templates.title: Install one curated skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Install the curated skill named [skill name]. Report the installed destination.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add one known package from the default collection.

prompt_templates.title: Install from a repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Install the skill at [repository path] from [owner/repository]. Use ref [branch, tag, or commit].
prompt_templates.scenario: Install a selected skill from a specific GitHub source.

prompt_templates.title: Provision pinned skills
prompt_templates.prompt: Install skills at [first path] and [second path] from [owner/repository]. Pin ref [commit], use Git mode, and report destinations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Provision multiple skills from an immutable repository revision.

output_examples.input: List curated skills and show which packages are already installed.
Install the selected skill from its GitHub repository path.
output_examples.output: Installed document-tools to the configured Codex skills directory.

output_examples.input: Install an internal skill from a private GitHub repository.
output_examples.output: Installed internal-tools after authenticated GitHub access completed successfully.

best_practices: Review the repository and SKILL.md before installing any third-party skill.
Pin third-party installations to an immutable commit whenever possible.
Use a least-privileged GitHub token and remove it from the environment afterward.
anti_patterns: Do not install from an unknown repository based only on the skill name.
Do not use a broad GitHub token when read-only repository access is sufficient.
Do not bypass an existing destination error without reviewing the installed copy.

faq.question: Where are skills installed?
faq.answer: Skills are installed under CODEX_HOME/skills. The default location is ~/.codex/skills.

faq.question: Can this install skills from private repositories?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use existing Git credentials or GITHUB_TOKEN and GH_TOKEN for authenticated GitHub access.

faq.question: Does it overwrite existing skills?
faq.answer: No. Installation stops when the destination skill directory already exists.

faq.question: Which repository hosts are supported?
faq.answer: Only GitHub repository URLs and GitHub owner/repository names are supported.

faq.question: Does the installer verify skill safety?
faq.answer: No. It validates paths and required files, but it does not review the installed instructions or scripts.

faq.question: When is an installed skill available?
faq.answer: The installed skill becomes available to the agent on the next turn.
